It records the maintainer's decisions of 2026-10-27, the corrections of the cross-family check (research/china-labs-2/codex-check-2026-10-27.md) and the admission's own checks. Every passage added or changed here is a part of a passage the pack matched twice, or was re-read at admission from a direct retrieval whose SHA-256 equals the pack's retrieval of the same file.

c2-baidu-ernie-3-titan-pcl.subject: ernie-3-titan-report
c2-baidu-ernie-3-titan-pcl.statement: The ERNIE 3.0 Titan paper (arXiv version 1, 23 December 2021) names Peng Cheng Laboratory as the affiliation of four of its authors; the other authors are marked with Baidu Inc.
c2-baidu-ernie-3-titan-pcl.qualification: An author affiliation printed on the title page, recorded as the paper’s credit to the laboratory, not as publication. It does not establish the laboratory’s role in training, compute provision or funding, or any relation between the two institutions beyond the shared paper.

c2-baidu-ernie-3-titan-report.qualification: Most authors are marked with Baidu Inc. and four with Peng Cheng Laboratory; the paper’s credit to the laboratory is recorded separately and implies nothing about direction or control. The paper’s statements about model scale and performance are not recorded.

c2-baidu-ernie-2019-report.qualification: Attribution to Baidu rests on the single affiliation “Baidu Inc.” given for all authors on the title page. The record does not establish the model’s performance, a release of code or weights, or the paper’s later peer-reviewed form.

c2-governance-tc260-asgf-v2-cncert-named.subject: tc260-asgf-v2-0
c2-governance-tc260-asgf-v2-cncert-named.statement: The AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0 (September 2025) names CNCERT/CC (国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心) beneath TC260 on its cover, and its preface says that TC260 organised CNCERT/CC and other professional bodies, research institutes and companies to prepare it.
c2-governance-tc260-asgf-v2-cncert-named.qualification: What the document states about who prepared it. TC260 is recorded as the publisher; CNCERT/CC is not recorded as a publisher, and its role is not equated with TC260’s. The CAC news item of the release says that the work was led and organised by CNCERT/CC (国家互联网应急中心); that is CAC’s statement and is kept as context.

c2-governance-sail-frmf-v1-concordia.subject: sail-frontier-ai-risk-management-framework-v1-0
c2-governance-sail-frmf-v1-concordia.statement: The Frontier AI Risk Management Framework (v1.0), July 2025, names Concordia AI with Shanghai AI Laboratory in its citation line, and its executive summary says that Shanghai AI Laboratory introduced the framework in collaboration with Concordia AI.
c2-governance-sail-frmf-v1-concordia.qualification: The document’s own credit. Shanghai AI Laboratory is recorded as the publisher; Concordia AI is not recorded as a publisher. The division of work is not recorded.

c2-governance-aiia-aisc-published.qualification: CAICT’s post says that AIIA drafted and issued the text, and the cover names AIIA. The text and the signatory list are published only as an image in the post; the records quote or describe a transcription of that image. People’s Daily Online’s text reproduction (29 December 2024) omits 红队 (red-team) in Commitment II; the image and the itcloudbd reproduction include it. The text describes itself as industry self-discipline; it is not a law or regulation, and this record does not establish its effect.

c2-governance-aiia-aisc-safety-team.qualification: What the commitment text says. The primary expression is an image; the quotation is a transcription of it, and the same wording is machine-matched in a text reproduction. Not evidence that any signatory has such a team.

c2-governance-aiia-aisc-pre-release-red-.qualification: What the commitment text says. The primary expression is an image; the quotation is a transcription of it. People’s Daily Online’s reproduction (29 December 2024) reads 进行测试 (testing) without 红队 (red-team); the image and the itcloudbd reproduction both read 红队测试. That copy is context for its own wording and does not support the red-team term. Not evidence that any signatory carried out such tests.

c2-governance-aiia-aisc-frontier-researc.qualification: What the commitment text says. The primary expression is an image; the quotation is a transcription of it. 不可控 is rendered as uncontrollability. Not evidence that any signatory carried out or published such research.

c2-moonshot-k2-readme.statement: The README of Moonshot AI’s Kimi-K2 GitHub repository, at the repository’s initial commit dated 11 July 2025, introduced two model variants, Kimi-K2-Base and Kimi-K2-Instruct, and pointed to their checkpoints on Hugging Face.

time.note: Date of the repository’s initial commit, which contains the README (11 July 2025, 14:28 UTC). The cross-family check found that GitHub’s repository record gives a creation time of 3 July 2025; a commit date and a repository creation date are different kinds of date, and neither establishes when the repository or the weights became public. The Hugging Face repository moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct also shows commits from 11 July 2025.

c2-moonshot-k2-licence.statement: Moonshot AI’s Kimi-K2 repository states that both the code repository and the model weights are released under a licence headed “Modified MIT License”; the README and the LICENSE file are present at the repository’s initial commit of 11 July 2025.

time.note: Date of the repository’s initial commit, which contains the LICENSE file and the README’s licence section; it does not establish when the repository became public.

c2-moonshot-k2-report-redteam.qualification: What the report states about its own evaluation; the results and their adequacy are not recorded. The report states that, to minimise subjectivity, it conducted multiple rounds of human review and assigned the same reviewer to all cases in a given test set. Not evidence of compliance with any commitment.

c2-moonshot-k3-licence.statement: The LICENSE file in Moonshot AI’s Kimi-K3 Hugging Face repository, at a commit of 27 July 2026, is headed “Kimi K3 License” and defines the licensed software to include the model weights, parameters, configuration files, and inference and training code.

time.note: State of the LICENSE file at the cited commit (27 July 2026, 15:14 UTC). The commit dates this expression of the licence; it does not establish when the weights or code were first released or became public.

c2-moonshot-k3-licence.qualification: The licence is described as the text describes itself; no judgement is made whether it meets any definition of open source. Its grant is subject to numbered conditions; the condition for Model-as-a-Service businesses is recorded separately.

c2-moonshot-k3-licence-maas.statement: The Kimi K3 License states that if the licensee or any of its affiliates operates a “Model as a Service” business, as the licence defines it, and the aggregate revenue of the licensee and its affiliates exceeds 20 million US dollars (or the equivalent) over any consecutive 12 months, the licensee must enter into a separate agreement with Moonshot AI before using the software or its derivative works for any commercial purpose.

time.note: Statement of the LICENSE file at the cited commit of 27 July 2026; the commit does not date the licence’s first publication.

c2-moonshot-k3-licence-maas.qualification: What the licence text states. Section 2 defines Model as a Service as giving a third party access to model inference or fine-tuning with meaningful control over inputs, parameters or training data, and excludes end-user products whose model capabilities are embedded in specific features or harnesses, and the mere relaying of requests to models hosted by others. Section 4 exempts internal use, and use through Moonshot AI’s official products or certified inference partners, from Sections 2 and 3. The condition is not one on every commercial user. Whether it applies to any named business, and enforcement, are not recorded.

c2-moonshot-k3-card.statement: The Kimi-K3 model card on Moonshot AI’s moonshotai Hugging Face account, at a commit of 27 July 2026, states that the full Kimi K3 model weights are released under the Kimi K3 License.

time.note: Date of the cited Hugging Face commit; the commit list begins with an initial commit on the same day. The commit date does not establish the moment the weights became public.

c2-moonshot-k3-card.qualification: The card’s statement as the developer makes it. Repository commit dates do not establish when the repository became public.

c2-minimax-m3-licence.statement: The MiniMax-M3 Hugging Face repository carries a licence headed “MINIMAX COMMUNITY LICENSE” at a commit of 13 June 2026; its grant covers dealing in the software for non-commercial purposes, and its conditions set terms for commercial use.
c2-minimax-m3-licence.qualification: The licence is described as the text describes itself; no judgement is made whether it meets any definition of open source. The commercial-use conditions are recorded separately. The same licence text is present in the repository’s initial commit of 12 June 2026.

c2-minimax-m2-licence-oct.qualification: The licence is described as the text describes itself. The file was changed on 13 November 2025 (recorded separately). The repository’s initial commit, dated 25 October 2025 at 21:28 UTC (26 October in UTC+8), carried the Apache License 2.0 text, which the MIT text replaced on 27 October 2025; the same-family audit found this in a Git clone and the cross-family check confirmed the initial text and its date.

time.note: Submission date of arXiv version 1, from the arXiv stamp and submission history. The same version 1 PDF prints an internal date, “Date: June 13, 2025”, on its first page. The two dates are of different kinds and are kept apart; no explanation of the difference is inferred, and neither is the model’s release or API availability date.

c2-bytedance-seed-15-vl-report.qualification: The report’s architecture and benchmark statements are not recorded. The record does not establish a release of weights; the report says the model is accessible on Volcano Engine, which is hosted access.

c2-bytedance-seed-oss-release.qualification: The card’s benchmark statements are not recorded. An existing record already uses this card for Seed’s stated founding year.

time.note: Date printed on the page; read on 27 October 2026. The formation of the department is recorded separately.
